note: Both sets capture the window/door identifiers, elevations and railing/cladding materials correctly, but Set A binds the datum labels more faithfully (elevation 18'-0", 2'-9 1/2", 0'-0") and preserves the note-2 condition that tube-array spacing may be larger, plus the APSE-20 model and the 1/4"=1'-0" scale. Set B adds two good facts A misses (40 tubes total, A-511 Hardie reference, 1/8" cable diameter) but mislabels elevations as 'height'/'dimension', includes a trivial 'PV SOLAR ARRAY presence: installed' claim and several duplicates. Both share the vague 'roof/overhang = PV SOLAR ARRAY' claim; on balance A has fewer misbound or trivial claims.
